title: Quant tricks & number bank
body:
# Quant Tricks — fast methods for every repeating template

> Companion to `score-80-playbook.md`. Each trick: when to spot it → the move → 15-second example. Practice refs point into the app bank (Quant deck) and `quiz-1/2.md`.

## 0. Number bank (memorize once, earn daily)

- Squares 11–30: 121, 144, 169, 196, 225, 256, 289, 324, 361, 400, 441, 484, 529, 576, 625, 676, 729, 784, 841, 900
- Cubes 2–12: 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, 1000, 1331, 1728
- Powers of 2 to 2^10: 2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512,1024
- % ↔ fraction: 50=1/2, 25=1/4, 20=1/5, 12.5=1/8, 10=1/10, 16.66=1/6, 33.33=1/3, 14.28=1/7, 11.11=1/9, 9.09=1/11, 8.33=1/12, 6.25=1/16, 6.66=1/15
- km/h→m/s ×5/18; m/s→km/h ×18/5

## 1. Simplification / approximation

- **Split %**: 48% of 650 = (50%−2%) = 325−13 = 312. Never multiply 0.48 directly.
- **Round first**: 31% of 1001 ≈ 30% of 1000 + 1% ≈ 310. Approximation Qs punish exactness.
- **BODMAS with division last**: 15×12÷4+8 → multiply first (180), divide (45), add (8) = 53.
- **Conjugates**: 19×21 = (20−1)(20+1) = 399. a²−b² hunting.
- **a³−b³ identity**: (0.7³−0.6³)÷(0.7²+0.6²+0.7×0.6) = 0.7−0.6 = 0.1. Bracket shape = cancel, don't expand.

## 2. Number series (spot in 10s)

1. Constant difference? → extend. 2. Constant ratio? → multiply. 3. ×n±k (×2+1)? 4. Squares/cubes ±k (numbers near 122, 344 scream cubes)? 5. n(n+1) pronic (2,6,12,20,30…)? 6. Alternating two patterns? 7. Differences of differences (second-order)?
- Wrong-term: rebuild rule, the misfit pops out (…,32,63 → should be 64).

## 3. Quadratics & equations

- Factor hunt: x²−Sx+P → two numbers with product P, sum S (x²−24m+135: −15×−9=+135 and −15−9=−24 → roots 15,9).
- Clear fractions FIRST: (m−16)=32/(m−12) → cross-multiply, then factor.
- Compare roots, don't fully solve when asked "relation": sign of roots often suffices.
- Linear pair (age/mixture style): one equation in x, e.g. 3x+10=2(x+10) → x=10.

## 4. SI / CI

- SI = linear: P·r·t. Doubling in n years → rate = 100/n (double in 5y = 20%).
- CI amount = P(1+r)ⁿ. 2-yr effective at 10% = 21%; at 20% = 44%.
- **CI−SI (2y) = P(r/100)²** — one step (4000,10% → 40).
- Read the ask: amount vs interest (12100 vs 2100 trap).

## 5. Time–Work–Pipes

- Add rates: 1/a+1/b; together = ab/(a+b). Three workers: sum three fractions.
- Remaining worker: 1/A = combined − other (1/6−1/10=1/15).
- Man-days constant: men×days fixed (15×10 = 10×15).
- Pair-sum trick: (P+Q)+(Q+R)+(R+P) rates = 2×all → halve, subtract to isolate.
- Pipes: inlet +, outlet −. Negative net = empties.

## 6. Speed–Time–Distance–Trains–Boats

- Platform/pole: speed = platform ÷ (platform-time − pole-time) = 600/20 = 30.
- Two bodies toward each other: ADD speeds; same direction: SUBTRACT.
- Boat: downstream = still+stream; upstream = still−stream; still = avg of the two; stream = half their difference.
-  advance-planning: convert units before anything (72 km/h → 20 m/s).

## 7. Percentages / Profit / Discount / Ratio / Average / Age / Mixture

- Reverse %: divide (20% of X=60 → X=300).
- Successive +a% then −b%: net = a−b−ab/100 (+20/−20 → −4%).
- Price↑r% hold spend: cut r/(100+r) (25% → 20%).
- P&L on CP; discount on MP. CP-15=SP-12 → gain (15−12)/12=25%.
- Join ratios via LCM of shared term (2:3 + 4:5 → 8:12:15).
- Averages: totals first (5×27=135, minus 4×25=100 → excluded 35).
- Ages: total now vs then differs by headcount×years (3 people, 5y → +15).
- Partnership: profit ∝ capital×time (2×6 : 3×4 = 1:1).
- Mixture: track the UNCHANGED component (milk 30L stays; total 40→50; 60%).
- HCF: min exponents; LCM: max exponents; N = HCF×LCM/known.
- Probability: count favourable ÷ total (die even = 3/6; two-dice sum-9 = 4/36).

## 8. Mensuration 30-second kit

- Square a²/4a · Rectangle lb/2(l+b) · Triangle ½bh · Circle πr²/2πr · Cube a³/6a² · Cuboid lbh/2(lb+bh+hl) · Cylinder πr²h/2πr(h+r)
- Cuboid shortcut: V = √(product of 3 face areas) = √3600 = 60.
- 7-14-22 triple with π=22/7 (r=7 → 154).

## 9. DI set routine (15 marks, same 5 moves)

For each set, in order: ① totals ② differences ③ % vs 'than'-base ④ averages/ratios ⑤ price×qty. Never read options before computing the column totals — parts chain.

## 10. Exam-hall checks (30 seconds, saves 2 marks)

- Units match? (min vs hours, m vs km)
- % base = 'than'-party? Amount vs interest? Length vs length+platform?
- Option trap scan: round-number and off-by-one options are usually wrong.
- Mark-and-move at 90 seconds; no sunk cost.

title: Score-80 playbook (cutoff math + attempt plan)
body:
# Score-80 Playbook — NICL AO Prelims (100 marks, −0.25)

> Built from YOUR papers: `papers/NICL-PYQ-2024-Prelims.md` (100Q), `papers/NICL-PYQ-2017-English.md` (100Q), `papers/NIACL-PYQ-2013-English.md` (100Q mixed), `papers/archive/*` (NIACL 2016–2023). Counts below are real, not generic advice.

## 1. The math of 80

Score = Correct − 0.25 × Wrong. Two viable routes:

| Route | Attempt | Right | Wrong | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A — sniper | 85 | 82 | 3 | **81.25** |
| B — volume | 92 | 86 | 6 | **84.5** |

Route A needs ~96% accuracy; Route B ~93%. **Take A**: 15 skips is plenty, and every blind guess costs 0.25. Golden rule: **attempt only when ≥70% sure; skip everything else on first pass, return if time remains.**

Sectional floors are qualifying (not merit) but mandatory — never sacrifice a section. Minimum safety line per section: **Eng 18/30, Reas 20/35, Quant 20/35**, then push total to 80.

## 2. Topic weightage (NICL 2024 Prelims — your main paper)

**English 30** — RC fasting 10 (Q1–10) · Para-jumble 5 (Q11–15) · Error detection 5 (Q16–20) · Sentence improvement 4 (Q22–25) · Fillers/blank 5 (Q26–30)
**Reasoning 35** — Box puzzle 5 (Q31–35) · Blood + word-formation 4 (Q36–39) · Fruit seating 5 (Q40–44) · Coding 5 (Q46–50) · Floor-flat 5 (Q51–55) · Syllogism + odd-one 5 (Q56–60) · Circle seating 5 (Q61–65)
**Quant 35** — Quadratics 5 (Q66–70) · DI Atlas/Dictionary 5 (Q71–75) · Simplification 5 (Q76–80) · DI items 5 (Q81–85) · DI class boys/girls 5 (Q86–90) · Arithmetic 10 (Q91–100: train, work, square, SI, partnership, average, age, mixture, percent, spend)

Cross-paper check: 2017 English = RC + cloze + vocab (same English DNA). 2013 = error/improvement/narration + coding/analogy + arithmetic. 2012 Reasoning = series/coding/puzzles/ranking. **Puzzles+seating ≈ 20/35 Reasoning every cycle. DI ≈ 15/35 Quant. Grammar+vocab ≈ 20/30 English.**

## 3. Repeating patterns (drill these first — they repeat verbatim in style)

1. **Syllogism 'Only / Only a few'** (2024 Q56–58; bank: reasoning 30 cards) — Only A are B reverses; only-a-few = some + some-not. ~5 free marks.
2. **Coding by common-word isolation** (2024 Q46–50; 2013 Q44 pattern) — overlap sentences, cancel common words. ~5 marks, zero theory.
3. **Quadratics factor-first** (2024 Q66–70) — cross-multiply, factor, compare. 5 marks in ~6 min.
4. **Simplification/approximation** (2024 Q78–80; 2013 Q88 identity) — BODMAS + rounding + a³−b³ identity. 5 marks, fastest in paper.
5. **Error-spotting fixed pairs** (2024 Q16–25; 2013 Q5/Q14) — pronoun case, has/have, to+base verb, Despite-without-of. Same 6 rules yearly.
6. **Fillers = collocations** (2024 Q26–30; 2017 cloze blanks 2,3,5,6,8) — reserve stock, in a bid to, plenary, prohibit, endeavour. Read them aloud; ear decides.
7. **DI four operations** (2024 Q71–90) — difference, % vs 'than'-base, average, ratio, price×qty. Same 5 moves × 3 sets = 15 marks.
8. **Seating with a twist** (2024 Q40–44 T–K swap; floor-flat interchange) — redraw, never overwrite. Second question in a set is always the twist.
9. **Blood-relation inside-out** (2024 Q36–38; 2013 Q35 cousin; 2012 Q6 mother) — decode innermost phrase first.
10. **Arithmetic greatest-hits** (2024 Q91–100) — train/(platform), work-share, SI-rate-change, average-via-total, mixture-track-milk, %−of−remainder. Same 10 templates as 2013 Q80–99.

## 4. The 80-mark attempt plan (60 min, sectional 20′ each)

**English (20′) — target 26/30.** Order: fillers 5 (4′) → error/improvement 9 (7′) → RC 10 (8′) → para-jumble last (1′, attempt only sure ones). Skip jumbles freely — worst ROI.
**Reasoning (20′) — target 26/35.** Order: syllogism+odd-one 5 (4′) → coding 5 (4′) → blood/word/rank 4 (3′) → ONE full puzzle set, your best type (8′) → second set only if ahead. Never start a third puzzle.
**Quant (20′) — target 28/35.** Order: simplification 5 (3′) → quadratics 5 (4′) → easiest DI set 5 (5′) → arithmetic pick-5, easiest first (6′) → remaining DI with leftover time. Skip mensuration outliers on sight.

26 + 26 + 28 = 80. Attempt ≈ 86, accuracy bar ≈ 95%.

## 5. What to skip (buying accuracy)

- 3rd puzzle set in Reasoning; number-pair oddities; dice-figure Qs without diagrams.
- Para-jumbles beyond 2 attempts; RC inference options with 'always/never' absolutes.
- Arithmetic with 3+ unknowns; probability beyond single-die; cube-painting counts.
- Any Q unreadable in 20 seconds — mark, move, return.

## 6. 7-day drill (fits your 2h/day)

- **D1:** Syllogism 30Q + coding 20Q (bank: reasoning). Target 95%.
- **D2:** Quadratics 25Q + simplification 25Q (bank: quant). Target 100% on simpl.
- **D3:** One 2024 DI set ×3 timed + error-detection 20Q.
- **D4:** Full 2024 Prelims timed (60′). Log every miss by pattern # above.
- **D5:** Fix worst 2 patterns (40Q) + fillers/cloze 30Q.
- **D6:** Full 2017 English timed (English stamina) + 1 puzzle set.
- **D7:** Rest morning. Formula + collocation + port/code sheet review only.
- Daily: 20 app questions (streak alive) + 10 flashcards.

## 7. Mock scoreboard (track this, not just marks)

After each mock record: Attempted / Right / Wrong / Score / Time left per section / Pattern of each miss (#1–10). You are ready when two consecutive mocks hit **78+ with ≤4 wrong** — exam-day adrenaline covers the rest.
